summary: Adds a 'Test connection' menu item for active MCP integrations backed by a login-checked server action that re-syncs tools.

statements.text: Nothing flagged (plain reads logins, payments, database changes and secrets. It doesn't run the code, and it can miss bugs.)

The agent also changed mcp.ts, mcp.validation.ts, list-tools.ts and sync-tools.ts in ways plain can't describe yet.
